notes.title: DEV. LOG # 3 | Update 0.4 Alpha
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 🎉

I've made a significant change to the main character—upgrading to a full-body MetaHuman! 

I believe this greatly enhances the character's presence and overall immersion in the game. 
Previously, the character was just the classic floating arms, which always felt a bit off to me (even if it wasn't super noticeable).

Now, with the new full-body model, I've also added:

Improved IK animations for a more dynamic feel.
A new move: 
the Slide, complete with a touch of bullet time 

This is just a quick update to share these changes. 
I've also been working on the AI, adding some new animations, but I'll save the details for the next update.

Thanks for your support

notes.title: DEV. LOG # 2 | Update 0.20 Pre-Alpha
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Excited to share some major updates I've made with [b]"Better Than Dead"[/b]...

I've been diving deep into a [b]new AI[/b], leveraging UE5's Environmental Query System (EQS) for enemies. This means our adversaries are now more cunning, utilizing the environment for cover and executing smarter maneuvers, fundamentally elevating the tactical depth of combat.

In addition to refining enemy AI, I've introduced a new animation and logic for when enemies reload their pistols. This detail adds another layer of realism and strategy, as you can now anticipate moments when enemies are vulnerable, providing tactical opportunities for attack.
For those curious about the technical side or wanting to see these improvements in action, I'm including a demonstration video.

[previewyoutube=tLlSLcYNGJY;full][/previewyoutube]

The protagonist's pistol has undergone a [b]ballistic overhaul[/b]. It's a complete rework to ensure shooting feels more realistic and satisfying.
Movement and aiming have been refined to better capture our protagonist's narrative: a girl driven by vengeance, yet devoid of formal combat training. These adjustments bring her movements and aim closer to someone learning as they go, not a seasoned warrior.
This change is subtle but crucial in making every encounter feel more genuine and connected to her story.

I'm also thrilled to introduce our [b]advanced particle and destruction system[/b], a significant enhancement that brings our environment and combat interactions to life. This new system, demonstrated in the video, allows for more dynamic  destruction and particle effects.

[previewyoutube=vwCDFiWMLRM;full][/previewyoutube]

A new level is in the works - [b]the warehouse[/b].
It's designed to challenge your adaptability, with intricate layouts and environments that play into the hands of our smarter enemies.

Thanks for following along. Please, spread the word about my project.
Working solo without a publisher, I rely on player support!

[b]Feedback, Advice, and Suggestions:[/b] are always welcome and greatly appreciated.

-MonteGallo

notes.title: DEV. LOG # 1 | Update 0.18 Pre-Alpha
notes.content:
[p]Welcome to the inaugural development update for Better Than Dead (BTD). 


[/p][previewyoutube="M7Pgb7v0JW8;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
[b]Why no HUD?[/b] For realism. Every fight is raw without a HUD. It's tough, but that's the point.

[b]Why bodycam?[/b] It's my second game with a bodycam effect, I love it when a game makes you feel inside, and a virtual camera that simulates a real one has always had that effect on me. Plus, I came up with a cool and plausible story that justifies it!

[b]The story?[/b] It's about revenge. 




[b]Current Progress - Version 0.18 Pre-Alpha:[/b]

[b]Camera and Animation Improvements:[/b] I've enhanced the responsiveness between the camera movement and the protagonist's arms. Animation transitions are now smoother.

[b]New Level Design:[/b] Work has begun on a level inspired by a Hong Kong brothel/nightclub, 

[b]Sound Effects (SFX) Integration:[/b] The initial batch of sound effects is being integrated, bringing the game's world to life with ambient sounds and NPC interactions, adding layers of immersion to the environment.

[b]Content Censorship Material[/b]: A censorship material has been implemented to thoughtfully address sensitive content within the game.

[b]NPC Behavior and Variety:[/b] Improved NPC behavior overall, introducing more variety in their reactions. Some enemies will now attempt to flee, adding a new layer of realism and unpredictability to encounters.

[b]Enhanced Detail of Civilian NPCs:[/b] Increased the level of detail for "civilian" NPCs. This is a first step to see how the game and its fluidity respond to enhanced NPC facial details.

[b]Added a new "nude" civilian model[/b], necessitating the implementation of the censorship material mentioned earlier.


I'm working on the project alone, so I have a lot to do.
[b]Feedback, Advice, and Suggestions:[/b] are always welcome and greatly appreciated. Let me know what you think, either here or on BTD [url="https://discord.gg/uQGDyGxuSE"]Discord[/url]  channel. 

...And remember to [b]Wishlist[/b] BTD [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2599690/Better_Than_Dead/"]Here[/url] on Steam!


-MonteGallo
[/p]
